marketing_wrapper: Almost entirely marketing. 03 (Packs rip art), 04 (graded trading cards with '$8M VALUE' starbursts) and 06 (an NBA partner lockup on a neon retro grid) contain no UI. 01 and 02 show a small phone held by a person in a lifestyle photo on a purple gradient, so the UI is about 15-20% of the frame, tilted and low-resolution. 05 shows enlarged pick-card components floating on purple: real components, but restaged with no app chrome. Captions mix an ultra-condensed light sans, a heavy condensed lime-green sans and a monospaced typewriter kicker ('IN BONUS LINEUPS'). Overall about 10% real UI.

typography.display: Marketing: ultra-condensed sans in light and heavy weights ('PLAY $5 GET $50'), heavy italic condensed ('RIP PACKS.'), plus a monospaced typewriter face for small all-caps kickers. In-app (from 01, 05): heavy condensed all-caps for player surnames and team names ('STAFFORD', 'BRUNSON', 'GAME WINNER LOS ANGELES').
typography.body: unsure (too small to read; a geometric sans for tab labels and chips)
typography.numerals: condensed heavy for lines ('263.5', '26.5', '80.5', '21.5'); small condensed caps for the stat label ('PASS YARDS', 'REC YARDS')
typography.weights: Black condensed for names and lines; regular small caps for metadata ('LAR • QB', 'DAL • WR')
typography.case_and_tracking: All-caps throughout the pick cards with tight tracking; tracked monospaced caps for kickers

palette.accent_strategy: Brand-flooded: an electric lime (#9cff27) is both the promotional highlight and the primary action ('MORE' button fill, selected card outline, '+' wallet button, the balance figure '$1,027'). Violet (#6104bc / #220647) floods the banner and backdrop. Jersey renders carry team colour per card. No goblin-green or demon-red pick modifiers are visible in these frames.
palette.source: palette.json 06 (#0e101d 27%), 02 (#191828, #9cff27 17% lime), 01 (#6104bc, #220647 violet; #24243c surface), 04 (#f7f4f8 white). Most clusters are marketing; the in-app values come from the small phone in 01 and 02, so treat them as approximate.

Confetti-and-multiplier 'arcade' mechanics (sports-study cliché: deposit-match promos, packs, '$8M VALUE' starbursts)

direction_fit.why: Binary LESS / MORE pick cards, a deposit-match and pack-rip promo layer, trading-card 'grails' and a lime-on-violet neon shell match the Pick'em Arcade signature. The text record's specific evidence (goblin and demon modifiers, payout hidden until submission, gross-winnings profile) cannot be confirmed or refuted from these frames: no slip, profile or modifier icon is visible. Confidence is med, not high, because only about 10% of the pixels are real UI.

notes: Too marketing-heavy for a confident visual record; re-check with device captures of the Board, slip and My Lineups. Scoreboard anatomy: no score, live state, Live Activity or widget is shown. Team colour and logos: carried by 3D jersey and helmet renders ('NEW YORK 11', 'DALLAS 88') and game-winner art (team-coloured basketballs and helmets) instead of crests. Betting and odds typesetting: the line is the hero numeral (heavy condensed white, '263.5'), flanked in 05 by ↓ and ↑ arrows in outlined circles; on the in-app card (01) LESS is an outlined dark cell and MORE is a lime-filled cell with an up-arrow icon, so the 'over' choice is the visually promoted one. No multiplier, payout or entry amount is visible anywhere. Money in the shell: wallet balance '$1,027' in lime with a lime '+' add-funds button. Game-winner cards ('GAME WINNER · LOS ANGELES · TO BEAT KANSAS CITY') show the 2026 combo-picks product.
